$comment: Front matter for rooms (connect-lesson-map/1). Rooms stay HTML. data/lesson-map.json is the catalog checked by scripts/validate_lessons.mjs.

properties.key: string, '<track>/<room id>', and rooms/<room id>.html must exist
properties.title: string, must equal the room h1
properties.outcomes: array of at least one phrase from the room, each at least 8 characters
properties.sources: array of at least one id from data/sources.json
properties.last_verified: null or YYYY-MM-DD. null means a human has not re-checked this row in this wave
